list-intro: Every ad test round: the directions AI drafted, the sample images and the full-test results, newest first.
list-empty-description: New tests are set up in Marketing tests.
legacy-notice: This older test flow has been retired: its tests can be viewed but no longer changed, generated or imported into.
legacy-notice-link: Start new tests in Marketing tests
new-intro: Answer three questions, or start with the defaults. AI drafts a few creative directions; nothing is generated until you confirm.
new-product-not-ready: This product hasn't been confirmed and published yet. Go back to the product page and confirm the product card first.
new-quick-summary-no-audience: Defaults: {{goal}}, using the audience on the product card, {{scale}}.
q-goal-explore-hint: Start from the product card and draft a few different creative directions.
q-goal-optimize-hint: Start from assets that already passed review and vary them.
q-seeds-empty: This product has no approved assets yet. Explore new directions first, then come back to improve the good ones once they pass review.
q-seeds-required: Improving existing ads needs at least one asset.
q-audience-custom-placeholder: e.g. Commuters who just bought an EV and have their own parking spot
q-audience-none: The product card has no audience. Write one sentence, or leave it blank to use the product description.
q-audience-loading: Reading the audiences on the product card
q-scale-sample-hint: 1 image per direction, usually 3–5 in all, to check the directions first.
q-scale-small-hint: Up to {{combinations}} combinations, {{variants}} images each, {{images}} images at most.
q-scale-full-hint: Up to {{combinations}} combinations, {{variants}} images each, {{images}} images at most.
q-scale-note: Once the plan is drafted, each size shows its exact image count and maximum cost, and you confirm again before generating.
plan-not-found: This test plan wasn't found. It may belong to another workspace or have been deleted.
plan-drafting-body: This usually takes under a minute. You'll then see 3–5 directions, each saying what it tests.
plan-stalled: Nothing has changed for a long time.
plan-failed-title: No plan could be drafted this time
plan-failed-cost-hint: AI drafting calls that completed may be charged even though the plan failed; no images were generated. Drafting again makes new calls.
plan-failed-bind-key: Bind an OpenAI key to draft with the real model.
directions-intro: Each card is one idea to test. Delete the ones you don't want, reword them, or add an idea of your own; the image count and cost update as you go.
direction-factor-min: Keep at least one value for each factor
add-idea-field-title-placeholder: e.g. Scheduling a charge with one tap in a garage on a rainy night
add-idea-field-scene-placeholder: What is in the picture, where, and who is using it
totals-scale-hint: Make samples first to check the directions; expanding fills in the size chosen here (with “Samples first”, it expands to the full test).
totals-full-adds-nothing: Each direction has only 1 combination, so the full test would not test any new element. Edit a direction and pick one more value for a factor to widen the test.
totals-locked: The full test has been submitted, so the plan can no longer change. Start a new test round to try other directions.
action-expand-waiting: Samples are still generating; you can expand once they finish
action-expand-hint: Look at the samples, delete the directions you don't want, then expand.
confirm-sample-body: 1 combination per direction, {{images}} images in all.
confirm-expand-body: New combinations to generate: {{combinations}} · {{variants}} images each · {{images}} images in all.
confirm-expand-reused: The {{count}} combinations already generated as samples are reused and not charged again.
confirm-expand-reused_one: The {{count}} combination already generated as a sample is reused and not charged again.
confirm-cost: Maximum cost: {{cost}}, charged by actual usage.
confirm-free: Example mode: makes example images at no charge.
results-unmatched: {{count}} more images couldn't be matched to a direction; you can see them in Assets.
results-unmatched_one: {{count}} more image couldn't be matched to a direction; you can see it in Assets.
problem-revision_conflict: The plan was just changed elsewhere and has been refreshed. Please try again.
problem-precondition_required: The plan on this page was out of date and has been reloaded. Please try again.
problem-test_plan_locked: The full test has been submitted, so the plan can no longer change. Start a new test round to try other directions.
problem-test_plan_not_ready: The plan is still being drafted. Try again once drafting finishes.
problem-test_plan_run_in_progress: Generation is being submitted. Wait a moment and try again.
problem-sample_run_in_progress: Samples are still generating. Expand to the full test once they finish.
problem-nothing_to_generate: Every combination at this size has already been generated; there is nothing more to generate.
problem-credential_required: The generation defaults use OpenAI, but the workspace has no usable key yet.
problem-guardrail_exceeded: This generation would exceed the workspace's spending limit.
problem-spend_guardrail_exceeded: This generation would exceed the workspace's spending limit.
problem-mode_unavailable: The current execution mode is unavailable. Check the generation defaults.
problem-model_unavailable: The model in the generation defaults is unavailable. Check the generation defaults.
problem-entitlement_unavailable: Your current subscription doesn't include this generation feature.
problem-too_many_directions: There are too many directions. Delete some before adding more.
problem-direction_removed: This direction was deleted. Restore it before editing.
problem-direction_not_found: This direction is no longer in the plan. The page has been refreshed.
problem-product_not_published: Confirm the product card (publish the product) before setting up an ad test.
problem-product_archived: This product is archived and can't be tested any more.
problem-audience_card_out_of_range: The chosen audience is no longer on the product card. Choose again.
problem-seed_assets_required: Improving existing ads needs at least one asset.
problem-seed_asset_not_found: One of the chosen assets is no longer available. Choose again.
problem-legacy_test_plans_frozen: This older test flow has been retired and is view-only. Start new tests in Marketing tests.
problem-template_invalid: The test factors AI generated failed validation. Adjust the directions and try again.
problem-template_publish_failed: Something went wrong submitting the generation. Please try again.
problem-too_many_factor_values: This factor has too many values.
problem-direction_factor_missing: Keep at least one value for each factor.
problem-generation_defaults_owner_only: Only the Owner can change the generation defaults.
problem-provider_mode_mismatch: The execution mode and the model don't match.
problem-aspect_ratio_unsupported: This model doesn't support the chosen aspect ratio.
problem-variants_invalid: The images per combination exceed the model's limit.
problem-provider_unavailable: The chosen generation service is unavailable.
problem-unknown: That didn't go through. Please try again later.
problem-ask-owner: Ask the workspace Owner to handle this.
banner-mock: Example mode: generation makes example images without calling OpenAI and without charges.
banner-byok-missing: Generation defaults use OpenAI, but no usable key is bound yet, so generation requests will be refused.
banner-member-action: Ask the workspace Owner to bind an OpenAI key in Settings.
defaults-intro: Tests no longer ask for a model and aspect ratio each time; everything generates with these settings. Generations already submitted are not affected by changes.
defaults-read-only: Only the Owner can change the generation defaults.
internal-intro: Raw identifiers and data for troubleshooting. They don't affect the plan.
